# Argon2 reference implementation

Vendored from the PHC winner Argon2 repository:

- Upstream: https://github.com/P-H-C/phc-winner-argon2
- Commit used for the initial vendoring: `f57e61e19229e23c4445b85494dbf7c07de721cb`
